title: How the proof fits together
intro: Explore the twelve stages of the cloning proof. Select a stage to see the ingredients it uses, the results it reaches, and their Lean pointers. This curated roadmap follows the mathematical argument.
legend: Ingredient arrows show contributions to the argument explained in a later stage. Comparison arrows identify an established benchmark, rather than a construction ingredient. Each edge links to compiled Lean declarations explaining the connection.

evidence.name: Cloning.YoungHyperplane.headDensity_l1_tendsto
evidence.note: Uses the moving-spectrum Young L¹ limit in the exact dither coordinates needed by randomized dilation.

evidence.name: Cloning.YoungHyperplane.fixedBaseYoungDensity_l1_tendsto
evidence.note: Recenters the moving-spectrum Young L¹ limit at the fixed LAN base spectrum.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.eventually_uniform_kernel_factorization_bound
evidence.note: Invokes the shrinking-window mixture theorem to bound the lifted payoff by orbital fidelity times kernel affinity, with discarded-mass error.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.eventually_uniform_typical_transitionFidelity
evidence.note: Uses the concrete qualitative Cartan transition-fidelity limit on typical pairs, rather than the named quantitative PBW rate theorem.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.universalKeep_transitionFidelity_tendsto
evidence.note: Uses the moving-spectrum qualitative Cartan transition limit for retained universal labels, not the named quantitative rate endpoint.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.knownSpectrumChannel_payoff_lower_typical
evidence.note: Assembles the concrete sector-mixture lower bound and atypical-mass loss; it does not invoke the generic lifted-factorization endpoint.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.eventually_uniform_universalAffinity
evidence.note: Calls the uniform fallback-output affinity theorem to obtain the universal cloner's classical factor.

evidence.name: Cloning.MixedLANTransfer.limsup_minimax_le_modeFactor_of_mixed_approximation
evidence.note: The converse chain uses the general optimized Gaussian payoff limit; it does not call the score-window endpoint directly.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalCloningConverse.limsup_knownSpectrumValue_le_of_compactWindowLAN
evidence.note: Applies the Gaussian transfer bound after removing the classical register for the fixed-spectrum orbit.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalCloningConverse.limsup_statePayoff_le_modeFactor_of_approximations
evidence.note: Calls the general mixed Gaussian converse with physical approximations, retaining both classical and orbital factors.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalCloningConverse.limsup_unknownSpectrumValue_le_of_compactWindowLAN
evidence.note: Uses that physical payoff bound on local spectral windows; this is a converse interface, not a direct call to the score-window endpoint.

evidence.name: Cloning.TensorCloning.limsup_knownSpectrumValue_le
evidence.note: Instantiates the known-spectrum converse with the constructed physicalCompactWindowLAN witness.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalCloningConverse.limsup_unknownSpectrumValue_le
evidence.note: Instantiates the unknown-spectrum converse with the constructed physicalCompactWindowLAN witness.

evidence.name: Cloning.PCTPhysicalFidelity.physical_pct_fidelity_unitary
evidence.note: Instantiates the PCT fidelity-transfer theorem with constructed compact-window LAN; no LAN premise remains.

evidence.name: Cloning.ValueExpansion.known_physical_target_brackets
evidence.note: Calls knownSpectrumValue_tendsto and combines its squared limit with the scalar small-gain expansion.

evidence.name: Cloning.ValueExpansion.universal_physical_target_brackets
evidence.note: Uses prescribed universal-cloner convergence, rather than pointwise unknown-spectrum minimax optimality.

evidence.name: Cloning.ValueExpansion.pct_physical_target_brackets
evidence.note: Calls the physical PCT fidelity limit before transferring the scalar squared-infidelity expansion to finite samples.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalAllStateMinimax.limsup_value_le_universalValue
evidence.note: Restricts the all-density adversary and invokes the unknown-spectrum converse; subsequent scalar infimization gives a bound, not an exact all-state optimum.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalAllStateMinimax.fullChannel_payoff_lower
evidence.note: Uses the finite PCT Werner lower guarantee on every density matrix, including singular and repeated-eigenvalue states; it does not assume a simple-spectrum limit.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalFlatGrassmann.minimaxValue_tendsto
evidence.note: Establishes the projector-family optimum used as the comparison benchmark.

evidence.name: Cloning.PhysicalFlatPCT.fidelity_limsup_lt_optimal
evidence.note: Proves PCT's strict loss against the benchmark formula; this comparison does not claim a direct proof-term call to the Grassmann minimax theorem.
